findings.claim: 存储登记不能由逻辑值或动作 noun 代替；身份按 worker 实例延续，而非按 phase 名重建。MoE direct 的 Census 与 Exchange 跨两个 phase 留在同一 CTA；root FC1/FC2 的同名 PayloadA 则是两次 kernel 的独立分配。
findings.recommendation: 保留并改名 storage。保留 location、depth、shape/dtype、必要 view 与成员范围；一块分配只记一次。沿用 launch.order/handoff 判断存续；存储名字或 YAML alias 均不提供依赖。
findings.other_definitions: index 只给版本命名，event 只给动作事件命名，都不能给出分配身份、容量或重叠区域。
findings.elimination_trial: 删除 MoE direct 的 resource，剩余 Census 数学标量和 handoff 仍不知道该值留在每个 CTA 的 SMEM；Exchange 的 WarpCounts/FinalRoutes 共用也无法从数学值推出。把这些写到 math 或 describe 只是移动存储账。

evidence.quote:
`domain` 在 phase 中统一登记共享索引的身份与边界，采用以下形式：

| 形式                          | 含义                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[lower, upper]`            | 半开整数域，依次取 `lower` 至 `upper-1`                                                              |
| `worktile`                  | 这个 worker 按处理顺序得到的全部工作，包括预分配的和运行时领取的；取值是本地序号，不是全局 worktile 编号 |
| `{flatten: [outer, inner]}` | 把已定义的有序域积按字典序连续编号，后一个域变化更快；内层范围可以随外层取值变化                         |

多个 role 需要共同解释一个索引，或资源视图要用到它时，在 `domain` 中定义一次，各 role 写 `for(i)`。只在一个 role 内使用的索引直接写成局部范围 `for(j=0:2)`，不进 `domain`。域的边界能用上游名称表达时就引用名称，例如 chunk 数 `Nc`、每份工作的迭代数 `N`，不写算好的数字，以免上游规模改变后本区仍保留旧值。

`worktile` 的长度可能到运行时才知道：`refill` 不是 `none` 时，worker 何时停止由上游的 `exit` 决定，此时不对它使用 `last` 或 `count`。运行时领取本身（例如查询下一份工作，再把坐标交给其他 role）是某个 role 的普通动作，其他 role 进入下一份工作前对它的等待是普通的依赖。

多个 role 使用同一个域，不代表它们同时进入同一轮：每个 role 独立推进，只受自己的顺序和依赖约束。

findings.claim: milestone 是局部事件接口，单事件、七个角色的事件组、消费侧 await.done 都有真实用途。生产聚合的全部完成与消费目标的逐事件约束必须分开解释；仅约束一组最晚成立时点不足以保护其中较早的读取。
findings.recommendation: 改名 event，保持已有事件引用列表与全部满足规则。补清：ready 展开为全部相关生产事件；wait_at 对每个列出的实际目标事件施加就绪约束。显式 role/member、工作索引与区域匹配继续沿用；不新增 runtime 通知、全局 alias、all/any 字段或事件种类。
findings.other_definitions: 事件可命名存储释放或输入等待，但 event 本身不分配存储、不生成索引、不产生可见性。
findings.elimination_trial: 删除 GDN prep_ready 并省掉 wait_at 会把 prep 完成等待移到消费 worktile 入口，失去先读 initial_state 的安排；允许 work_schedule 直接引用 role::await 又只是把局部事件接口耦合进调度语法。MoE 七角色列表还会随每个调用处展开。
findings.logical_witness: 若生产就绪在 5、两个消费端点在 2 和 7，只约束全部消费端点已发生的聚合时点 >=5 仍容许第一个消费过早。数字是规则反例，不是实际测量。所选 MoE 分支还存在启动/PDL 传递保护，本条不声称观察到该分支发生过早读取。
findings.scope_note: MoE 的七个角色都在一个 CTA 成员内；Epilogue[*] 不等价于 Epilogue、Epilogue0、Epilogue1、Epilogue2。[*] 选择 worker 成员，不选择 warp 或 role。

`milestone` 只给已有的事件组起一个对外名称，所列事件全部发生时成立；它不产生数据可见性、跨 CTA 通知或轮询，这些机制由 role 中的实际动作承担。`kernel_done` 与 `launch_ready` 是第 4 篇定义的内建事件，不能作为局部里程碑重新定义，也不能通过添加索引来重定义。

里程碑的键可以带索引，如 `snapshot_ready(c)`，索引与所引用事件中的同名索引对应。生产侧的里程碑绑定真实的完成或发布事件；消费侧按 [`wait_at` 规则](4.design.work_schedule.md#交接字段)绑定实际等待或读取事件。

**`milestone` 没有当前 role / member 上下文**，所列事件必须写成完整形式，显式给出 `Role[selector]` 与时点，selector 为成员编号或 `*`。

| `.ready`       | 生产者里程碑引用或非空引用列表                                                | 可消费时点不是生产 worktile 完成时填写         | 覆盖默认的生产就绪时点                                          |
| `.wait_at`     | 消费者里程碑引用或非空引用列表                                                | 消费者可以先做独立工作、稍后才等待该值时填写   | 覆盖默认的消费入口等待；每条引用自带所属 phase                  |

省略 `ready` 表示相应生产 worktile 完成、且交出的区域已满足消费者所需的可见性；省略 `wait_at` 表示消费 worktile 开始前该区域必须就绪。这两条是设计约束，不会自动生成发布标志、跨 CTA barrier 或轮询协议，相应机制由 [tile_pipeline](5.design.tile_pipeline.md#跨-phase-交接) 给出。

显式 `wait_at` 通过消费者里程碑定位数据必须就绪的事件：可以是等待动作的 `done`，或真正读取动作的 `issue`。等待本身可以提前开始，其 `issue` 不表示数据已就绪。

findings.claim: slot/view 映射和容量是主干事实，不能因其像地址公式就交给 Coder 自行选择；但 total_size 是派生校验值，不是另一份独立设计决定，也不是 kernel 实際总预留。
findings.recommendation: 保留必要 slot_index/part/dtype 与 total_size 的现有校验等式，可由工具生成总字节数，不增加第二套 bytes/stride/lifetime 字段。本轮不提出把 total_size 改成省略字段。区分设计登记的逻辑存储账与 realization 中有因果作用的实际预留；视图映射不规定 lane 地址或 swizzle。
findings.other_definitions: view 用 index 的版本作参数，但不捕获某个 role 当前游标；reuse 需要动作/waiting，不能从总字节数或区域相交推导同步。

launch_tcg requests TcgSmem<128,PASS_FUSED,1>::bytes=102912 before
        tmem_safe_smem applies its runtime occupancy-based request adjustment.
        This includes the unused 16384-byte shared probability reservation,
        512-byte shared Q-scale reservation, 1024-byte exchange reservation and
        1024-byte alignment allowance in addition to the live shared resources.
        The helper publishes the dynamic-memory attribute and queries occupancy,
        increasing the request by 4096 bytes while blocks*256>512. It stops on
        an API error, at 96 attempts, or when a request at least 220000 bytes
        still fails that bound. It returns the last request after retrying any
        unpublished attribute and clearing the error; this is not a residency
        guarantee. launch_tcg caches this request for later calls.
      reason: >-
        The actual shared-memory reservation affects CTA capacity even though
        probabilities reside in TMEM. The host helper compensates for runtime
        occupancy accounting that does not include the 256 TMEM columns per CTA.

After preparation writes and all old OperandArena readers and asynchronous fills have finished, nonempty valid
                  rows load MTail and form weighted FP32 numerators; empty splits stage zeros. Each valid row
                  writes D channels into the PartA view of OperandArena. Its 81920-byte operand capacity holds the 67584-byte
                  staging span including row spacing; padded rows are neither staged nor later read.
                  For Ng>0, the loop's current-slot transfer waits and QK/PV completion retire all old arena uses; the last group
                  enqueues no future transfer. For Ng=0 there are no K/V fills or matrix readers. A CTA barrier after staging
                  publishes the staged rows and joins final TMEM readouts; done includes this barrier.

release: >-
                  DotPair(n) joins the read completion of every epilogue row
                  and returns its TMEM pair slot; the final register FMA has
                  not yet executed. Staging(t,f) instead waits, through the
                  bulk source-read completion primitive, for every outstanding
                  earlier full-tile store to stop reading OutputStaging, then
                  rendezvous all epilogue members. The first full tile has no
                  earlier store to wait for. Tail tiles retain this store history.
                publish: >-
                  Output(t,f) converts F to BF16 in OutputStaging for a full
                  tile; all writers publish to the asynchronous access domain
                  and rendezvous before the elected store lane may proceed.
                store:
                  execution_mode: async
                  meaning: >-
                    Output(t,f) issues the two full-height 64-column bulk
                    transfers to the owned out region and commits them as one
                    group. Done means global writes are complete. The next
                    worktile may start while these writes remain in flight.

| `total_size` | 字节数，整数或整数表达式 | 必填                                                                     | 这块分配在一个 worker 内的总占用，等于 `depth × 单槽字节数 × 持有成员数`                     |
| `member`     | 成员序号或序号列表       | 只有部分成员持有这块存储时填写                                           | 省略表示 worker 的每个成员各有一份                                                               |
| `view`       | 视图具名映射             | 一块存储要放多个值、按索引轮转槽位、与别的值共用空间，或只占一部分时填写 | 见[视图](#视图)                                                                                   |

`total_size` 统一以字节记。省略 `member` 时持有成员数是 worker 的全部成员数，**不是 warp 数**。它是派生校验值：必须与 `depth`、`shape`、`dtype` 和成员范围构成的等式一致，不另设单槽大小字段，`view` 条目不重复计入。它只覆盖设计登记的存储，不含实现额外开销；多个 CTA 的 `total_size` 合计也不能直接对照单个 SM 的容量。

findings.claim: 存储别名不提供读写排序。FMHA xpose 空 split 与 GDN 最终 mini chunk 都有旧读者未退场即覆盖的来源风险；这不构成第四种 phase 定义。MoE 的条件 drain 已在当前工作稿放回显式前驱，不应继续称为尚只藏在文字中的新缺口。
findings.recommendation: 保留有据设计关系和短来源限制，迁移时将已有依赖表达为 waiting；不能靠 storage/event 名字自动补 join。MoE 条件等待用已有 if + await + released 转写，不再使用 0/1 假循环。没有足够来源保证时如实保留 source_or_draft_issue。
findings.other_definitions: resource、domain、milestone 本身都不能修复来源缺少同步；事件必须指向真实动作保证。

facets.item: FMHA stage_partials.issue 等待 prepare.done，以及 MoE 条件 drain 都已有表达位置。
原语自身的有序读后写保证可以短 describe 说明并绑定 realization；不强迫逐指令加边。

evidence.quote:
prepare:
                  execution_mode: async
                  meaning: Prefetch Q/scales, first-warp allocate 256 TMEM columns, CTA-publish the base and relinquish the permit.
                    Each thread writes Query/QueryScale/UnitScale, waits for its TMEM stores, discards QueryPrefetch and clears its
                    NumState before entering its scan wait. done guarantees that preparation, including all Query writes, has
                    completed across all warps. Independent scan waits may begin before this collective completion; the PDL wait
                    does not join the warps. Empty splits also perform preparation.
                dependency:
                  execution_mode: async
                  meaning: Each thread executes the PDL scan wait after its own preparation and before its first snapshot read.
                    done guarantees the predecessor scan's MState/MTail visibility, without initializing or extending those regions.
                    The wait does not join this CTA's warps or complete their Query writes.

stage_partials: >-
                  After preparation writes and all old OperandArena readers and asynchronous fills have finished, nonempty valid
                  rows load MTail and form weighted FP32 numerators; empty splits stage zeros. Each valid row
                  writes D channels into the PartA view of OperandArena. Its 81920-byte operand capacity holds the 67584-byte
                  staging span including row spacing; padded rows are neither staged nor later read.
                  For Ng>0, the loop's current-slot transfer waits and QK/PV completion retire all old arena uses; the last group
                  enqueues no future transfer. For Ng=0 there are no K/V fills or matrix readers. A CTA barrier after staging
                  publishes the staged rows and joins final TMEM readouts; done includes this barrier.
                  Source limitation: the empty-split path lacks a pre-staging join for Query writers and can violate this reuse ordering.

waits_for:
              data:
                replay:Entrance: [dependency:Scan]
              reuse:
                stage_partials:PartA: [prepare:Query]
              sync:
                stage:Operands(g)@done: [prepare:Query, replay:Entrance]
                stage_partials:PartA@done: [replay:Entrance]

Nonfinal chunks have no trailing CTA join: the next advance
                  retires the prior shared reads before stage/RhsOutput reuse.
                  On the last chunk, if FinalState is requested, each warp
                  immediately writes its R values to stage 0 at FP32 pitch
                  VTT+1, then joins the CTA to publish the staged final state.
                  Full-path overlapping K/Q/V reads were retired by earlier
                  joins/preloads. In a final mini chunk with (c_n-1)%NSTAGE=0,
                  stage-0 writes can race other warps' outstanding Kc row-0
                  reads; the source supplies no read-retirement guarantee.
                  Keeping this suffix in one action does not order those reads
                  before other warps' writes. Output global stores may still
                  be in flight; the source adds no separate store-drain wait.

pipe:
              repeat: t
              prologue: ["enter:Protocol"]
              steady:
                - repeat: {q: [0, "min(1,t)*(1-Hoist)"]}
                  steady: ["wait:Drain(t,q)"]
                - repeat: "g[t]"
                  steady: ["prepare:ScaleTM(g)", "mma:PayloadA(g)@PayloadB(g)"]
              epilogue: ["retire:TensorStorage"]
            waits_for:
              data:
                "prepare:ScaleTM(g)": ["AProducer/publish:AScale(g)", "BProducer/load:PayloadPair(g)", "BProducer/stage:BScale(g)"]
              reuse:
                "wait:Drain(t,q)@done": &prior_drain ["Epilogue/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue0/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue1/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue2/release:Accumulator(t-1)"]
                "mma:PayloadA(g[t,0])@PayloadB(g[t,0])": *prior_drain

findings.claim: 记录尺度可以变小：GDN final_store 把最后一次未使用的 current 赋值写进契约，无助于数学、容量或交接；FMHA 的不可达越界 guard 和 barrier parity 编码也不值得在 phase 公共定义新增字段。
findings.recommendation: 删除最后一次无效寄存器赋值的叙述，保留转置目标、分批下一批读取先于当前批存储的重叠关系、staging 生命周期与真正完成边界。普通地址、lane 算式、barrier 编号交给 Coder；影响占用的 reservation 或真实发布/复用 join 不能一起删。
findings.other_definitions: 三类公共定义只描述必要身份与约束；不把 Coder 的局部临时变量当第四种公共状态。

facets.item: 批次预读与写出的必要相对关系可用一句动作说明保留，无需补一套线程级循环 DSL。

evidence.quote:
final_store: |
                  If requested, transpose the staged state to [value,key]
                  global order. Per thread prefetch one float4 into a register;
                  in each of VTT/8 rounds load the next float4 before storing
                  the current one. The last round has no next load and its
                  subsequently assigned current value is unused. No worktile
                  follows in this CTA, and no speculative future chunk remains.
                  Shared/global retirement follows kernel completion; no extra
                  store-drain operation is present in the source.

setup: >-
                  Establish the work_schedule coordinates, row masks and completion
                  protocols. A q0>=Sq guard exits before allocation or copying;
                  the exact launch grid never takes it. Initialize separate
                  two-slot K/V transaction barriers and QK/PV completion phases,
                  each initially at parity zero, with initialization
                  published before bulk use. All 128 rows execute in root,
                  including padding; each thread owns one row for score readout
                  and row-state arithmetic. Thread 0 issues the matrix
                  products and TMA requests; the four warps cooperate on other work.

本区不重新决定数学、精度、工作组织、角色、缓冲或依赖，也不重复固定设备、语言和库版本。设计主张已经属于 Design，因此不设置 `thesis`；Planner 条目的理由由 `reason` 承担。

不影响既定数值与执行语义的代码组织、地址计算、barrier 编号和精确线程 layout，默认留给 Coder。调试日志、待办事项和完整实验报告不进入本区。

findings.claim: MLA Geo 上传后的 launch 等待、Sparse caller fork/join，以及跨调用缓存身份/复用都有真实语义，但不能由 worker 的 storage/index/event 冒充。源码确实执行外部准备与事件队列，问题不等于 phase 表达力不足。
findings.recommendation: 工作表的工作排序留在 work_schedule；外部供给/输出可用性归公共调用边界与调度；必要 CUDA 原语和物理缓存约定留 realization/调用约定。短句保留当前明确关系，若需要结构化外部引用应单独讨论上层范围，不能添加伪 host phase 或把 global cache 放入片上 storage。
findings.other_definitions: event 是局部已存在动作的出口，不凭空制造外部 host 上传、后继 caller 工作或跨调用版本；index 的 worktile 也不是 process cache 序号。
findings.issue_status: 指定旧报告已讨论 MLA/Sparse 外部边界及跨调用状态；capture-invocation-boundary 与 conditional-flow-topology 也已有归档。未把它们宣称为本轮首次发现的未提报问题。N2/N3 为本轮规则澄清建议，关键词查找无匹配不能证明全仓从未提报。

evidence.quote:
schedule:
          strategy: |
            Before the main launch, a nonblocking side stream copies SeqLens, CuQ
            and CuKV to pinned host buffers (4*(3*B+2) bytes); the host waits for
            these copies and constructs WorkCount table entries of 48 bytes each.
            Start from h ascending, b ascending, a descending. Stable-sort by N
            descending exactly when every q_b>=Bq and Scatter is false.
            Let CachedL2 and CachedSM be launch_impl's cached device-query results,
            refreshed while CachedL2 is zero. Let ScatterBytes =
            min(H*B,CachedSM if positive else 148)*max_b(k_b)*(QKDim+ValueDim).
            Scatter = CachedL2>0 and 4*ScatterBytes>3*CachedL2. This is a host
            locality heuristic, not a measured cache-capacity guarantee.
            Upload the complete Geo table on the side stream and record table_event;
            the main/current stream waits for that upload before the one main kernel.
            Only allocation capacity and descriptor encodings are cached, not reused
            numerical metadata. During external recording this host prefix still runs;
            later execution uses the recorded binding and the table contents actually read.
            Sinks has a payload only when present. LSE is stored only when ReturnLSE;
            neither option changes the work set or the main kernel submission.

thesis: |-
      Fork after the caller's preceding work, run the full-batch probe on a side stream
      and a packed prefix on the caller stream, then submit the accepted packed remainder
      behind the probe. The remainder need not wait for the prefix. Queue a side-to-caller
      join after the remainder and behind the prefix, so subsequent caller work observes
      all output rows. One probe and two attention launches
      plus the event pair permit overlap without promising simultaneous residency.
    flow:
      launch:
      - phase: [probe]
      - phase: [prefix]
      - phase: [remainder]
        start_after: probe.kernel_done

The caller first records a fork after its prior work; the side stream waits for
          that fork before reading input tensors. The host arms the mapped slots with -2
          and submits this full-batch probe to the side stream. It then submits prefix to
          the caller stream before polling at most 2000000 passes, stopping when a pass
          finds no -2. The final scan reads each slot once and computes probe's positive-only
          R. This node accepts packing and submits remainder using the initial P parameters.
          Polling may finish before probe.kernel_done. Side-stream order still prevents
          remainder from starting before probe completion; prefix has no probe completion
          wait. ProbeRatio is consumed only by the host, not by either attention kernel,
          so no tensor handoff connects these phases. ProbeCount follows probe's actual
          update order and can differ from the attention union count. The source also permits
          pending probe writes to race a later gate reset; selection uses the actual observed R.

schedule:
          strategy: >-
            The current CUDA stream orders prep, chain and reuse of the grow-only
            workspace across calls. Every consumed handoff slot is rewritten.
            The source provides no cross-stream event, lock or reentrancy protocol.

Global workspace persists across requests and graph replays; its R-row packed
      operand and route-result views retain unwritten bytes. Same-stream ordering
      orders their reuse; this path adds no cross-stream exclusion or host completion wait.

naming.method: 设计者从覆盖范围、术语冲突、长度和可能误读比较，未做用户可用性测试或词频实验。保留公共规范的单数字段风格。

choices.definition: Named on-chip allocations and their views for this worker.

candidates.name: resource
candidates.assessment: 现名宽于实际内容，易让人期待 Tensor Core、barrier 或 occupancy 资源也在此登记。

candidates.name: storage
candidates.assessment: 覆盖 SMEM/TMEM/register 及长期状态，惯用且直接；需在定义中明确片上与 worker 范围。与 handoff.storage 的职责相关，路径层级可区分。

candidates.name: buffer
candidates.assessment: 更短、GPU 中常见，但易使人只想到搬运数组或暂存，不自然涵盖寄存器标量、状态和混合解释区。

choices.definition: Named iteration indices and ordered sequences.

candidates.name: domain
candidates.assessment: 数学上准确，但孤立初读时用途较泛；不熟悉索引域的读者不易猜到。

candidates.name: index
candidates.assessment: 直接提示键是索引名，兼容整数范围、worktile 与 flatten；定义必须强调范围/序列声明而非当前可变游标。

candidates.name: range
candidates.assessment: 整数半开区间容易理解，但 worktile 与 flatten 是有序序列，且上游已有 range 表示规模允许范围，冲突更大。

choices.definition: Names for existing local events, used by cross-phase handoffs.

candidates.name: milestone
candidates.assessment: 英语常见，但易联想到重要进度或阶段末点，对消费等待、中段释放、单事件略带多余暗示。

candidates.name: event
candidates.assessment: 贴近 issue/done 引用，单事件和复合事件都自然；须定义为静态引用命名而非创建 CUDA event/notification。

candidates.name: marker
candidates.assessment: 可表达标记任意位置，但对多个角色的 AND 组及就绪保证不如 event 明确，也容易像无语义的调试标记。

naming.migration: 只替换三个 phase 字段名及对应的资源引用路径，保留条目结构、事件端点、索引形式和所有必要关系。storage/index/event 并非新的执行指令。
